critical_code_review_comments: workout-session.tsx Tip 2: spec says 'renders OUTSIDE the ScrollView/SafeAreaView so it doesn't get clipped'. Implementation places the popup AFTER `</ScrollView>` (line 494) but still INSIDE `</SafeAreaView>` (line 543). With position:absolute + zIndex:9999 + safe-area top padding only on the container, this is functionally equivalent for the intended UX (popup pinned 32px from screen bottom regardless of scroll). However, if iOS adds bottom inset padding to SafeAreaView in a later RN version, the bottom:32 could land above the inset. Consider moving the floating wrap outside SafeAreaView entirely (sibling, wrapped in a top-level <Fragment>) for maximum scroll/inset immunity.

create-post.tsx is now 3179 lines (was 3176 in iter-20) — continues to grow. The targets array spec (lines 2266-2288) is minimal but the file urgently needs splitting into ShareAchievementForm, MediaPicker, EditableStats, InstagramShare modules.

OnboardingOverlay.tsx labelCard now has only shadow (no gold border). Visual contrast is fine on dark backgrounds, but on the white/light overlay regions the card may lack edge definition. Consider a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08) subtle border as a middle-ground if visual feedback indicates the cards feel 'floaty'.

Backfill v3 logic (server.py 12730-12748) is gated solely on the v3 doc existence. If v3 backfill ever needs to run a 4th time (different reset criteria), the team must bump to v4 — not delete the v3 doc — to preserve audit history. Suggest a `version` field on the doc to make this explicit, e.g. {_id:'onboarding_backfill', version:3, ...}, with the gate checking `doc?.version === 3`.

Idempotency caveat: the v3 backfill resets ALL users to 'unseen', overwriting any 'completed'/'never' choices users already made. This is BY DESIGN per the review request ('users who already auto-completed tips get a clean replay'), but it WILL annoy power users who explicitly chose 'Don't show again' in iter-19/20. Consider a future, more-conservative backfill that only resets users whose state==='completed' but trackShown was never called (the auto-complete scenario), preserving explicit 'never' choices.
